scope: Actual readonly review of four existing licensed previews, official evidence, DESIGN and analytic draft; no assets/render/browser or source edits

findings.observed: Two full views support seven principal eave tiers, with six exposed elevated railing bands. The lowest broad tiled slope belongs to the base/storey1 eave candidate; enclosure coping crosses in front of it.
findings.action: Use exactly7level/eave IDs. Count and review both full-photo silhouettes before detail refinement; do not append a separategroundpavilion/eighthroof just because the lowest slope is wide. Keep enclosure wall/gate outside the tower owner.
findings.design_assessment: Current DESIGN correctly adopts this interpretation; basal assignment is not a measured survey.

findings.observed: Apparent roof-to-roof spacing decreases toward the top in the2015corner view; the six lower-to-upper intervals do not represent equal image heights. Both views show progressive upper silhouette narrowing.
findings.action: Keep per-level wall/platform/eave heights and radii independent parameters, then compare projected silhouettes in both photos. Do not directly use pixel width/gap ratios as physical taper or floor heights. Avoid an unjustified sudden waist or overly tall middle storey.

image_space_control_reuse.warning: Different roof depths, perspective and camera tilt remain; these are future projected-image checks only, not metric constraints.

findings.observed: 2016and2019closeups show broad sloping tile fields with corner rise; tile-end line, rounded rafter-end line and bracket zone are separate depth layers. A roof is not eight planar triangular fans or a uniformly upturned bowl.
findings.action: For the reviewed analytic formula, at face center(s=.5), outer radial derivative is(eave_mid_z-inner_z)+4*sag. If this is positive, the central outer strip rises out of a trough too. Unless deliberately supported by a traced local edge, constrain this derivative<=0 as an initial shape guard; reserve strong lift for corners. Keep sag and corner_lift independent, and make the currentabs(2s-1)^6 concentration adjustable during photograph comparison.
findings.limitation: No universal physical roof curve or fixed sag value is measured here; the guard detects an unintended shape family, not a new universal acceptance threshold.

findings.observed: Closeup83212925 shows an upper railing, a thick gray platform fascia and small support blocks beneath it; farther down lies a separately curved roof with tile ends/rafters and larger bracketsets.
findings.action: Model railing atop a deck edge, with fascia thickness and independent underside supports. Keep air/depth between deck-support and lower roof where visible; do not merge them into a single horizontal painted stripe or use roof surfaces as walkable balcony floors.

findings.observed: Railing is open rectilinear fretwork between larger posts, with a separate top rail and corner post caps. Bracketsets step out in several layers, along flat faces and in two directions at corners.
findings.action: Union overlapping2Drail bars before extrusion; maintain real voids and connect end modules to posts. Do not stretch one fretsymbol across an entire irregular edge or make it a darkopaqueplane. Use repeated face brackets plus distinct corner arms; retain round rafter ends in their own row under tile ends. Avoid identical unprofiled boxpiles for all brackets.
findings.limitation: Hidden branch joints, exact bracket taxonomy/dimensions and material grain are not measured from these previews.

findings.observed: 2015lower exposed levels alternate the dark cusped opening between adjacent visible faces;2016closeup has an opening onimageleft and solid yellow infill onimageright. That supports alternating through/blank treatment, not a geographic edge.
findings.action: Keep4through/4blind per level and alternate phase between levels; no opaque backplate over intended through openings. Keepfirst_level_open_parity and camera/geographic phase unresolved or explicitlyestimated. Existing2016GPS is only a candidatecamera constraint.
findings.reason: No alreadyverified gate/wall/source correspondence exists in this review. The white neighboring structures visible in2015mustnot be identified as a particular OSMhall solely by stylistic resemblance.

findings.observed: Full photographs show a slender dark stacked-ring shaft below the goldupper ornament and diagonals to the top roof; it is not anotheroccupiedstorey or a singlecone.
findings.action: Treat published32.3/40.64as nominalbody/total controls with an explicit chosen datum. Build coveredbowl/base/tray, seven substantial phase-rings and bottle as distinct profiles; do not count neckbands as extra phase-rings. Use four guycables distributed aroundthetop, not four adjacent octagoncorners. Document wireanchor parity independently from doorphase if not calibrated.
findings.additional_document_check: OfficialXuhuidistrict passage records the1980s replacementbottle as1.9m high. This can guide a nominal bottleportion sanitycheck, but its referenceplanes are not newlymeasured and8.34m remains only total-minus-body arithmetic.

findings.observed: Sunlit2016closeup is pale/washed out;2019brackets read dark partly because of occlusion. Railing/platform weathering is grayish rather than uniformly freshred. Base and stair geometry remain hidden.
findings.action: Prefer the chosen2019epoch for broad material tuning; do not bake shadow darkness or combine exposure differences into randommaterialpatches. Keep plaster/timber/tile/weatheredfascia separate. Use an explicit estimated base and omitted/unconfirmedstairs rather than inventing a detailed stair flight.

acceptance_limits: This is a pre-model visual/design review, not a mesh, dimensional, normal, native or browserPASS.
No new photographs downloaded; no pixel regions modified; no assumed optical calibration or exact floorheights.
The current seven-level design can proceed with clearlylabelled initial dimensions; the listed shape/ownership guards remain for actualgeometry and two-viewrender review.
